meta.title: AiGen-One | AI operations built with FDEs
meta.description: Expert FDEs understand your operations and design Skills, Agents, and business apps in AiGen-One, from implementation through adoption and continuous improvement.

hero.title:
Turn field operations into
AI systems people use.
hero.description: Our expert FDEs work inside your operation to understand the work and its constraints. They design Skills, Agents, and business apps in AiGen-One and stay through adoption and improvement.
proofs: Skills, Agents, and apps in one platform

fde.title:
Understand the work
before adding AI.
fde.description: Handing over another tool does not change operations. FDEs work alongside your people to map decisions, data, exceptions, and approval paths.
fde.note: A Forward Deployed Engineer is an AI implementation specialist who works directly with the field and owns delivery and iteration until the system is genuinely used.
fde.photoCaption: We learn the workflow and decisions where the work actually happens, not only in a meeting room.

steps.title: Understand operations
steps.description: Interviews and observation reveal manual work, tacit decisions, and links to existing systems.

steps.title: Design the right form
steps.description: A single capability becomes a Skill, a multi-step process an Agent, and work requiring screens and data an app.

steps.title: Drive adoption
steps.description: We configure access and approvals, deploy to the field, and improve continuously from real usage.

platform.title:
Work and AI,
in one workspace.
platform.description: From the daily Dashboard to AI consultation, specialist capabilities, automated execution, and custom systems, everything shares one organization, permission, data, and approval foundation.

layers.title: Dashboard
layers.description: Schedules, alerts, approvals, projects, and frequent work in one view.

layers.title: AiGen Chat
layers.description: Uses company knowledge and business data to advise and act.

layers.title: Skills
layers.description: Reusable specialist capabilities for translation, documents, analysis, and more.

layers.title: Agents
layers.description: Combine Skills, APIs, and MCP with human confirmation to execute work.

layers.title: Business apps
layers.description: Systemize unique work that needs interfaces, data, and workflows.

build.title:
After launch, teams can
keep building by talking.
build.description: Once the FDE has established the foundation, field managers and operators can add functions through conversation with AI. Everyday operational language becomes the entry point to development.
build.prompt: I want a screen that analyzes trends from historical sales data.

outputs.title: Skill Creator
outputs.description: Turn decision criteria and output formats into specialist capabilities available in AI Chat.

outputs.title: Agent Creator
outputs.description: Combine Skills and external services into an operating flow with sequence and human approval.

outputs.title: Business app generation
outputs.description: Create systems with lists, forms, search, and approvals through conversation.

journey.title:
Not just delivered.
Continuously improved.
journey.description: Discovery, design, implementation, rollout, and iteration stay connected. FDEs and AiGen-One keep AI from ending as a temporary proof of concept.

steps.title: Listen
steps.description: Share the problem and the ideal way of working.

steps.title: Decompose
steps.description: Map decisions, data, exceptions, and approvals.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Implement as Skills, Agents, and apps.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.description: Make it easy to use from the Dashboard.

steps.title: Improve
steps.description: Iterate from usage and field feedback.

outcomes.title:
AI systems shaped
for how your company works.
outcomes.description: Instead of teaching everyone a generic AI tool, turn the work itself into AI-assisted systems.

items.label: Sales
items.title: Proposals and opportunities
items.description: Generate proposals from meeting notes, save them to opportunities, and share next actions on the Dashboard.

items.label: Operations
items.title: Decisions and approvals
items.description: Encode internal standards as Skills and let Agents move work forward with checks and approvals.

items.label: Knowledge
items.title: Company data
items.description: Use policies, minutes, and business databases to answer, aggregate, and create documents within access rules.

governance.title:
Flexible to build.
Governed by the company.
governance.description: AiGen-One balances useful AI with responsible enterprise operations. FDEs design deployment around your existing controls.

items.title: Organization, access, approval
items.description: Control available data, Skills, Agents, and apps by department and role.

items.title: Audit and usage
items.description: Record who used, generated, and executed what, and use that insight to improve.

items.title: Existing system connections
items.description: Connect APIs, MCP, Google Workspace, Git, and other current business assets.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Plans reflect each user's role. FDE discovery and implementation are scoped to your target workflows and integrations.

plans.name: AI User
plans.features: Business User, AiGen Chat, Knowledge, Skills, Agents

plans.name: Workspace User
plans.features: AI User plus creation of Skills, Agents, and business apps

plans.name: Organization Admin
plans.features: Access, approval, limits, business menus, and integrations

pricing.note: Platform base fees, onboarding and FDE services, and custom development are priced separately.
